notes: This prompt's declared INPUTS block is much thinner than its actual context dependencies — Client Name/Website/Industry/ICP/CRO/Pillar Page/Competitor Analysis are never declared as fillable fields; they are pulled implicitly in the prompt's own Step 1 ('Read Context From This Conversation'). The context_reference fields below make those implicit reads explicit for the Context Resolver.

fields.label: Blog Topics / Working Titles
fields.raw_explanation: The topics the operator picked at the suggestion gate — a numbered list, each carrying its own primary keyword, search intent and funnel stage. The prompt writes one complete post per topic (Step 2 plans the set, Steps 3-7 run per post), so this field is a content batch rather than one title.

fields.label: Primary Keyword
fields.raw_explanation: YOUR ANSWER — the head term the whole set supports, usually the pillar page's. Each selected topic already carries its own primary keyword; this one anchors the set and covers any topic that arrived without one.

fields.label: Compliance Sensitivity
fields.raw_explanation: Healthcare / Financial / Legal / Other regulated field: specify / None

fields.label: ICP Document
fields.raw_explanation: Step 1B: full avatar profile from the ICP output — name, archetype, demographics, psychographics, core pains and fears, goals, objections, awareness level, decision criteria, and exact language/phrases.

fields.label: CRO / Brand Voice Framework
fields.raw_explanation: Step 1A: brand voice and tone as demonstrated in approved pillar page and funnel copy; any locked terminology/product/service names established earlier.

fields.label: Pillar Page
fields.raw_explanation: Step 1A: "The pillar page topic and structure — this blog must support and link back to it." Step 5 checklist requires a minimum of 1 internal link to the pillar page.

fields.label: Competitor Analysis — Blog
fields.raw_explanation: Step 1C: "Pull competitor content patterns from earlier in this conversation." Sourced from the paired Competitor Analysis — Blog stage (04_Blog.md) when available.
